people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The offspring of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners and stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.
translations.bsb: Those of Israelite descent separated themselves from all the foreigners, and they stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.
translations.kjv: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.
translations.asv: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.
